reason: Rabbit can load hosted assets and reach the authenticated core broker route. Release remains blocked until the route display fix is deployed and service/approval/privileged-executor gates are validated.

currentBlocker.summary: Rabbit-originated route/auth reachability is verified, but privileged execution is disabled and no Rabbit-native executor has been installed or validated.

releaseRequirements: Rabbit reaches a broker endpoint over HTTPS or a validated Rabbit-native local route.
Gateway relay has a public HTTPS URL and requires relay authentication.
Route substitute is one of: authenticated public HTTPS relay, proven private tailnet route, or validated Rabbit-native broker route.
Broker route, service status, approval dialog, and gateway relay probe all return controlled responses.
Relay requires authentication and exposes no OpenClaw, Hermes, Rabbit connector, GitHub, or broker secrets.
Privileged execution remains false unless a validated Rabbit-native broker later executes after live approval.
All release QR codes are labeled release-ready only after these checks pass.
testingRules: Testing QR codes are allowed only when explicitly labeled testing-only.
Testing QR codes must not be presented as deployment-ready.
Stop after setup if broker route is unreachable.
After route succeeds, continue only to the next explicitly requested non-privileged diagnostic.
Do not run service, approval, ADB, root, reboot, install, cleanup, or release checks without explicit review.
